verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party rules engine where a user defines event-to-action rules. Webhooks (call_started, call_ended, call_analyzed) only push events to the user's own server, so the user would have to build the rule logic themselves. That makes them a developer building block. Function calling is LLM-driven tool use during calls, and data retention and AI QA are fixed automatic behaviors, not user-defined event rules, so all three are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
